subject.title: [Feature]: Talk/Voice tab — agent/session switching + per-agent TTS voice

question: Should Talk/Voice mode share the Chat-selected agent/session, expose its own voice-specific picker, or use a config-only default session target?
rationale: Current main solves per-agent TTS configuration, but the unresolved half changes companion-app UX and session-state routing semantics and needs an owner decision before implementation.

options.title: Add Voice-specific picker
options.body: Expose an explicit Talk/Voice agent/session selector and route TalkModeManager through that selected session while keeping per-agent TTS under `agents.list[].tts`.

options.title: Share Chat selection
options.body: Make Voice/Talk reuse the active Chat session selection so one mobile session target controls both text and voice.

options.title: Config-only target
options.body: Document and support a configured Talk default session without adding a mobile picker, trading UX clarity for a smaller runtime change.

recommendation.title: Add Voice-specific picker
recommendation.body: Expose an explicit Talk/Voice agent/session selector and route TalkModeManager through that selected session while keeping per-agent TTS under `agents.list[].tts`.

likelyOwner.reason: They already separated the implemented TTS half from the remaining Talk/Voice routing work in the issue discussion and have recent history on the TTS side of the feature.
